stories.title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
stories.summary: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials, allowing them to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters.

stories.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
stories.summary: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.

stories.title: Report: Threat Actors Are Refining Their Use of AI Tools
stories.summary: Recorded Future warns that threat actors continue to use AI to accelerate their attacks, making traditional techniques such as phishing, supply-chain compromise, and extortion more effective.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
